spans.text: Source: AfriSenti-SemEval Shared Task 12 (Nigerian Pidgin / Naija, "pcm" subtask) Fetched directly from: https://github.com/afrisenti-semeval/afrisent-semeval-2023 (SubtaskA/{train,dev,test}/pcm_{train,dev,test}.tsv) This is the exact dataset CreoleVal's own nlu/sa/download_afrisenti.sh script fetches -- CreoleVal does not vendor the raw text in-repo, only the download script and MaChAmp training config (nlu/sa/configs/senti_afri.json), so this pocket fetched the real upstream files directly, the same way CreoleVal's own script would.
